yrbs.about: The 2025 Youth Risk Behavior Survey of the second video (10,710 students, 110 columns of codes, and its codebook as a frame). The result of the agent's cell [10] of its first dry run, rebuilt from the take's notebook; the levels of the loop variable r that the agent's first prompt carried, the lines that the guard's dialog showed; and the result of cell [23] of the recorded take2, from the text that its dialog showed.

columns.name: notes
levels: During the student's whole life (an adverse childhood experience). The user's guide's list of add-on questions numbers it Q90; the file holds it in Q89. The CDC's QN89 ('Reported that a parent or other adult in their home most of the time or always hit, beat, kicked, or physically hurt them in any way') counts answers 4 and 5 as Yes (1) and answers 1 to 3 as No (2). 1,869 blank; 1,806 of them are in 13 of the 108 schools where 80% or more of the students left it blank: those students probably got only their state or district questionnaire, which lacked this question (CDC, Technical Notes for Youth Health in Focus, 2026).

During the student's whole life (an adverse childhood experience). The user's guide's list of national add-on questions numbers them differently from the file (its Q90 is the question held in Q89); this codebook follows the file's SAS labels and formats. The CDC's QN88 ('Reported that a parent or other adult in their home most of the time or always insulted them or put them down') counts answers 4 and 5 as Yes (1) and answers 1 to 3 as No (2). 388 blank; 219 of them are in 3 of the 108 schools where 80% or more of the students left it blank: those students probably got only their state or district questionnaire, which lacked this question (CDC, Technical Notes for Youth Health in Focus, 2026).
